Generate dummy distribution data

Source: R/dummy_dist.R
dummy_dist.Rd

Generates dummy geographic distribution data for multiple species

dummy_dist(
  nsp = 10,
  max_occ = 10,
  xmin = 0,
  xmax = 5,
  ymin = 0,
  ymax = 5,
  step = 0.1,
  seed = NULL
)

Arguments

nsp

integer

max_occ

integer

xmin

numeric

xmax

numeric

ymin

numeric

ymax

numeric

step

numeric

seed

integer

Value

A data.frame with three columns

Author

Gilles Dauby, gildauby@gmail.com

dummy_dist(nsp = 5) ## five species dataset
